import numpy as np
from scipy import stats
from sklearn.metrics import roc_auc_score
from sklearn.linear_model import LogisticRegression
from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler

MAX_DRIVERS = 2

def design(feats):
    # Calculate effect sizes and p-values for each feature
    effects = []
    for i, fid in enumerate(feats.ids):
        x = feats.x[:, i]
        y = feats.y
        mean1 = np.mean(x[y == 1])
        mean0 = np.mean(x[y == 0])
        effect = mean1 - mean0
        t_stat, p_val = stats.ttest_ind(x[y == 1], x[y == 0], equal_var=False)
        auc = roc_auc_score(y, x)
        effects.append((fid, effect, t_stat, p_val, auc))
    
    # Sort by effect size (absolute value) descending
    effects.sort(key=lambda x: abs(x[1]), reverse=True)
    
    # Filter out correlated features (|r| >= 0.6)
    kept_features = []
    for fid, effect, t_stat, p_val, auc in effects:
        is_correlated = False
        for kept_fid, _, _, _, _ in kept_features:
            if abs(np.corrcoef(feats.x[:, feats.column(fid)], 
                              feats.x[:, feats.column(kept_fid)])[0,1]) >= 0.6:
                is_correlated = True
                break
        if not is_correlated:
            kept_features.append((fid, effect, t_stat, p_val, auc))
    
    # Select top features based on statistical significance
    significant = [(fid, effect, t_stat, p_val, auc) for fid, effect, t_stat, p_val, auc in kept_features if p_val < 0.05]
    
    # If no significant features, return empty design
    if len(significant) == 0:
        return Design(drivers=(), columns=(), products=(), loadings={})
    
    # Select drivers (most likely causes)
    drivers = tuple(fid for fid, _, _, _, _ in significant[:MAX_DRIVERS])
    
    # All features that will be used in regression
    columns = tuple(fid for fid, _, _, _, _ in significant)
    
    # No interaction terms in this simple approach
    products = ()
    
    # Weighted score using standardized values
    loadings = {}
    for i, fid in enumerate(columns):
        loadings[fid] = feats.x[:, i].std()  # Use standard deviation as proxy for importance
    
    return Design(drivers=drivers, columns=columns, products=products, loadings=loadings)
